{{Quote|We've got to hold off the ''Tyrant'' long enough to make the jump to lightspeed.|The captain, during the battle with the ''Tyrant''|<ref name="TPOVLSC" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Rebel Alliance in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] [[Champion (Mon Calamari cruiser)|''Champion'']], which was present above the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the Alliance's evacuation of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], its formerly secret headquarters. One passenger that the captain received on board the ''Champion'' was the Rebellion [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. After Madine came aboard the ''Champion'', the captain was about to order the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to retreat from the battle by jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], when the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] approached the ''Champion'' and prepared to attack. [[Xamuel Lennox]], the captain of the ''Tyrant'', hailed the ''Champion'' and ordered the captain to surrender Madine. The captain of the ''Champion'' refused and fought off the ''Tyrant'' long enough to make the jump to hyperspace in order to reach the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebels' rendezvous point]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Launch fighters!|The captain, ordering his fighters to launch against the ''Tyrant''|<ref name="TPOVLSC" />}}
[[File:Captain_Lennox_SWG-TPOV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Captain Lennox, the Captain's adversary during his battle with the ''Tyrant'']]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Alliance<ref name="TPOVLSC" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.</ref> he was the captain of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] [[Champion (Mon Calamari cruiser)|''Champion'']], which was present over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] while the Rebels' headquarters, [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], was being evacuated. During the latter part of the battle, Rebellion [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] was rescued from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="ISD">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]] states that [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron's]] five [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which according to {{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Captain Lennox}} includes Lennox's [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], were either [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-]] or [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]]. Given the inconsistency in the model of Star Destroyer used for the ''Tyrant'' in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], this article only assumes that it is an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].</ref> [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commandos]], and he and one of the commandos that rescued him were eventually sent on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the ''Champion''.<ref name="TPOVLSC" />

After Madine was on board, the captain of the ''Champion'' was about to order the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to activate the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], so that the ''Champion'' could travel to the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebels' rendezvous point]]. However, the ''Tyrant'', under the command of Imperial Captain [[Xamuel Lennox]], intercepted the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and launched [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]]. Lennox attempted to persuade the captain of the ''Champion'' to hand over Madine with promises that the ''Tyrant'' would not attack the cruiser. The captain refused to make a deal and ordered the launch of the ''Champion''{{'s}} [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. While commanding the fighters to be launched, the captain also ordered the commando who rescued Madine to take an X-wing and join the other fighters in holding off the ''Tyrant'', so that the ''Champion'' could make the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. After a battle with the ''Tyrant'', the surviving Rebel starfighters returned to the ''Champion'', which was then able to escape from the ''Tyrant'' and make the jump to hyperspace, eventually reaching the rendezvous point.<ref name="TPOVLSC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|There will be no deals.|The captain, when Captain Lennox asked him to hand over General Crix Madine|<ref name="TPOVLSC" />}}
When the ''Champion'' was under attack from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Tyrant'', the captain refused to be intimidated into giving up General Madine to the Imperials. During the confrontation, the captain did not panic and gave orders that allowed his ship to escape.<ref name="TPOVLSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel captain who commanded the Mon Calamari cruiser ''Champion'' first appeared in the mission text for the third scenario of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] campaign of ''[[The Price of Victory]]'', which was released in [[2010]] as the eighth set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. In the scenario, the player takes the role of the commando whom the captain ordered to help with the fighter attack. The card game was shut down at the same time<ref name="TPOVLSC" /> as its parent game, ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which was closed on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
